Rashi on Yevamot 10b:11:1.hebrew: ור' יוחנן - אמר לך: מי איכא מידי דמעיקרא אי בעי האי אח — חליץ, ואי בעי האי אח — חליץ, שהרשות ביד כולן; ולענין צרתה נמי, מעיקרא אי בעי — להאי חליץ, ואי בעי — להאי חליץ, והשתא, משום דחליץ חד לחדא, קאי על צרה בכרת, וכן אחיו על כולהו בכרת:
Rashi on Yevamot 10b:11:1.english: And Rabbi Yoḥanan - [He] says to you: Is there anything [such] that at the outset, if this brother wanted, he could perform ḥalitza, and if that brother wanted, he could perform ḥalitza — for the right is in the hands of all of them — and regarding her rival wife as well, at the outset, if he wanted, he could perform ḥalitza with this one, and if he wanted, he could perform ḥalitza with that one; and now, because one [brother] performed ḥalitza with one [woman], he stands [liable] to karet for the rival wife, and similarly his brothers [stand liable] to karet for all of them?

Rashi on Yevamot 10b:12:1.hebrew: האי שליחותא דידהו עבד - דמעיקרא היה הרשות ביד כולן, וכן היא שליחותא דצרה עבדה. וכי היכי דהוא עלה בלא יבנה, כן על צרתה בלא יבנה, וכן האחים על שתיהם:
Rashi on Yevamot 10b:12:1.english: This one performs their agency - For originally the option [to perform levirate marriage] was in the hands of all of them. And similarly, she performs the agency of [her] rival wife. And just as he [is prohibited] to her under "he shall not build," so too [is he prohibited] to her rival wife under "he shall not build," and so too the brothers [are prohibited] to both of them.

Rashi on Yevamot 10b:14:1.hebrew: אמאי צריכה חליצה - נהי נמי דקידושין תפסי בה, דאיהו לא קאי עלה בכרת, מיהו כשמת, תיפטר ותצא מן האחים משום ערוה, הואיל ובכרת היא עלייהו:
Rashi on Yevamot 10b:14:1.english: Why does she require ḥalitza - Even though betrothal takes effect on her, since he is not subject to karet on account of her, nevertheless, when he dies, she should be exempt and released from the brothers on account of [being] a forbidden relative, since she is [forbidden] to them under [penalty of] karet.

Rashi on Yevamot 10b:15:1.english: One of the brothers arose and betrothed her - [Meaning] that the one who performed chalitzah did not betroth her, rather one of the [other] brothers.

Rashi on Yevamot 10b:15:2.hebrew: אין לה עליו כלום - דאין קידושין תופסין לו בה, ואינה צריכה הימנו גט, דאין קידושין תופסין בחייבי כריתות:
Rashi on Yevamot 10b:15:2.english: She has no [claim] on him - For betrothal does not take effect for him with her, and she does not require a bill of divorce from him, since betrothal does not take effect in [cases of those] liable to karet.

Rashi on Yevamot 10b:16:1.hebrew: סיפא אתאן לרבי עקיבא - ורישא רבנן, ומיהו חייבי לאוין הוא דברי הכל:
Rashi on Yevamot 10b:16:1.english: [In] the latter clause, we have come to Rabbi Akiva - And the first clause [follows] the Rabbis; however, [it is a case of] those liable for a negative prohibition according to everyone.

Rashi on Yevamot 10b:1:1.hebrew: היתה אמו אנוסת אביו ונשאת לאחיו מאביו - קידושין תופסין בה, ואפילו לר' יהודה הקידושין תופסין בחייבי לאוין. וכשמת, נמצא' צרתה צרת ערוה ופטורה:
Rashi on Yevamot 10b:1:1.english: [If] his mother was a woman raped by his father, and she married his paternal brother - Betrothal takes effect with her, and even according to Rabbi Yehuda, betrothal takes effect with [women prohibited by] negative commandments. And when he dies, her rival wife is found [to be] the rival wife of a forbidden relation, and she is exempt [from levirate marriage].

Rashi on Yevamot 10b:2:1.hebrew: ללוי דאמר דאי נמי קתני - דהא מתני' רבי יהודה, ובדיק לה לוי אמו אנוסת אביו:
Rashi on Yevamot 10b:2:1.english: According to Levi, who said [the Mishnah] also teaches "what if" - For our Mishnah [follows] Rabbi Yehudah, and Levi added to it [the case of] his mother who was violated by his father.

Rashi on Yevamot 10b:2:2.hebrew: וחזר וקדשה - וקידושין תופסין לו בה, דאינה עליו אלא בלאו, דכתיב: ״אשר לא יבנה את בית אחיו״ — כיון שלא בנה, שוב לא יבנה:
Rashi on Yevamot 10b:2:2.english: And went back and betrothed her - And betrothal takes effect for him with her, for she is [prohibited] to him only by a negative commandment, as it is written: "who does not build his brother's house" — once he has not built [it], he shall not build [it] again.

Rashi on Yevamot 10b:2:3.english: And died without children - And he had another wife.

Rashi on Yevamot 10b:2:4.hebrew: דמיגו דהיא אסורה - לאחים, דקיימא עלייהו בכרת לר"ל, דאמר לקמן בשמעתין האחין של חולץ חייבין על החלוצה כרת, צרתה נמי אסורה:
Rashi on Yevamot 10b:2:4.english: Since she is forbidden - to the [other] brothers, as she is forbidden to them under penalty of karet according to Reish Lakish, who says later in our sugya [that] the brothers of one who performs chalitzah are liable to karet for [relations with] the chalutzah, her rival wife is also forbidden.

Rashi on Yevamot 10b:3:1.hebrew: לפי שאינה בצרת צרה - דליכא למיתני בה "הלכה צרתה ונשאת לאחד מן האחין", דהא לכולהו אסירא. דכל עריות דמתני' על האחד מהם ערוה ועל שאר אחין מותרות, ומצי למיתני בה "הלכה צרתה ונשאת לאחיו השני", אבל הכא כולהו אחין אסירי בתרוייהו:
Rashi on Yevamot 10b:3:1.english: Because it does not [involve] a rival wife of a rival wife - For one cannot teach regarding it, "her rival wife went and married one of the brothers," since she is forbidden to all of them. For [with] all the forbidden relatives of the Mishnah, [the woman] is a forbidden relative to one of them and permitted to the other brothers, so one can teach regarding it, "her rival wife went and married his second brother"; whereas here, all the brothers are forbidden to both of them.

Rashi on Yevamot 10b:4:1.hebrew: ולימא ליה - רבי יוחנן לר"ל: חייבי לאוין נינהו האחין על חלוצה זו שחזרה ונפלה לפניהם, ולא קיימא עלייהו בכרת, דהא איהו פליג עליה דר"ש בן לקיש לקמן, ואמר: בין שאר האחים בין החולץ אין חייבין על החלוצה כרת, ולא על הצרה כרת:
Rashi on Yevamot 10b:4:1.english: And let him say to him - Rabbi Yochanan to Reish Lakish: The brothers are [only] liable for [violating] a negative prohibition regarding this chalutzah who again fell before them [for levirate marriage], and she is not subject to karet for them; for indeed he [Rabbi Yochanan] disagrees with Rabbi Shimon ben Lakish later on, and says: Neither the other brothers nor the one who performed chalitzah are liable to karet for the chalutzah, nor to karet for the rival wife.

Rashi on Yevamot 10b:4:2.hebrew: וחייבי לאוין בני חליצה ויבום נינהו - כלומר, זקוקה היא להתייבם, ואין איסור לאו פוטרה מן החליצה, דהא מאחות אשה ילפינן שהיא ערוה וחייבין על זדונה כרת, והלכך לא מצי למיתנייה במתני':
Rashi on Yevamot 10b:4:2.english: And those liable for [violating] a prohibition are [subject to] chalitzah and levirate marriage - That is to say, she is bound [to the levir] for levirate marriage, and the prohibition of a negative commandment does not exempt her from chalitzah, for we derive [the exemption of forbidden relatives] from [the verse of] a wife's sister, which is an ervah [a forbidden relation] for whose intentional violation one is liable for karet, and therefore [the Tanna] could not teach it in the Mishnah.

Rashi on Yevamot 10b:7:1.hebrew: על הצרה - אם היתה לה צרה ונפטרה בחליצתה של זו — דכתיב בית חלוץ הנעל, בית אחד הוא חולץ ואין חולץ שני בתים — ואותה צרה חמורה לעמוד על כולן באיסור אשת אח בכרת, שנפטרה מהן, כדמפרש טעמא:
Rashi on Yevamot 10b:7:1.english: For the rival wife - If she had a rival wife and she was exempted through this one's ḥalitza — as it is written, "the house of the one whose shoe was removed": he performs ḥalitza for one house, and does not perform ḥalitza for two houses — [then] that rival wife is [treated] stringently, remaining [forbidden] to all of them under the prohibition of a brother's wife [punishable] by karet, since she was exempted from them, as [the Gemara] explains the reason.

Rashi on Yevamot 10b:9:1.english: As they stood, they stand - In the prohibition of a brother's wife.

Tosafot on Yevamot 10b:16:1.hebrew: וליתני לר"ע אין לו עליו כלום - תימה, דבפרק המדיר (כתובות דף עה:) איכא כי האי גוונא, דתנן: "היו בה מומים ועודה בבית אביה — האב צריך להביא ראיה; נכנסה לרשות הבעל — הבעל צריך להביא ראיה", ומסיק בגמרא דרישא ר' יהושע וסיפא ר"ג, ולא פריך ולימא: "לדברי ר"ג נאמנת, ועל הבעל להביא ראיה", ולא הוה צריך למיתני תרי בבי:
Tosafot on Yevamot 10b:16:1.english: And let [it] teach: According to Rabbi Akiva, he has nothing against him - [This is] puzzling, for in the chapter [entitled] Hamadir (Ketubot 75b) there is a similar case, as we learned in a Mishnah: "If she had blemishes while she was still in her father's house — the father must bring proof; [if] she entered the husband's domain — the husband must bring proof," and the Gemara concludes that the first clause [reflects the opinion of] Rabbi Yehoshua and the latter clause [reflects the opinion of] Rabban Gamliel, yet [the Gemara] does not ask: Let [the Mishnah] say, "According to Rabban Gamliel, she is believed, and it is upon the husband to bring proof," and it would not have needed to teach two [separate] clauses.

Tosafot on Yevamot 10b:3:1.hebrew: לפי שאינן בצרת צרה - הקשה הר"ר משה כהן: לר"ש איתא בצרת צרה, כגון שנולדו אחים להן אחר שחלץ ליבמתו וקדשה, דלא קיימין עלה ב"לא יבנה", כדאמרינן לקמן בסמוך; ולוי מיירי בפלוגתא, כיון דקתני אנוסת אביו גבי שש עריות בסיפא, דהיינו כרבי יהודה! וי"ל דבפלוגתא דלא סבר לה לא קמיירי, כדפי' לעיל, ולוי לא סבר כר"ש באשת אחיו שלא היה בעולמו:
Tosafot on Yevamot 10b:3:1.english: Because they are not in [a case of] a rival wife of a rival wife - Rabbi Moshe Kohen asked: According to Rabbi Shimon, it exists with a rival wife of a rival wife — for example, where brothers were born to them after he performed chalitzah to his yevamah and betrothed her, for they are not subject regarding her to [the prohibition of] "he shall not build," as we say shortly below; and Levi deals with disputed [cases], since he teaches "the woman violated by his father" among the six arayot at the end [of the baraita], which is in accordance with Rabbi Yehudah! And one can answer that in a disputed [case] which he does not hold, he does not deal [with it], as we explained above, and Levi does not hold like Rabbi Shimon regarding the wife of his brother who was not in his world.

Tosafot on Yevamot 10b:6:1.hebrew: החולץ ליבמתו וחזר וקדשה - וליכא למימר דנקט "וחזר וקדשה" לאשמועינן דהוא אינו חייב על החלוצה כרת, אבל לאו איכא לפי שקדשה — דאמרינן בקידושין (דף עח.): "מודים במחזיר גרושתו שאם קידש ולא בעל שאין לוקה, דרך בנין בית אסרה תורה". אלא נקט "קדשה" משום דאם מת, פליגי רבי יוחנן ור"ל אם זקוקה ליבם לאחיו אי לאו; ולא נקט "וחזר ובא עליה", דבהא לא פליגי רבי יוחנן ור"ל, דלכולי עלמא אינו חייב על החלוצה כרת, וה"ה דהוה מצי למנקט "וחזר ובא עליה אחד מן האחין":
Tosafot on Yevamot 10b:6:1.english: "One who performs ḥalitza with his yevama and went back and betrothed her" - And one cannot say that [the Gemara] stated "and went back and betrothed her" to teach us that he is not liable to karet for the ḥalutza, yet there is a negative prohibition because he betrothed her — for we say in Kiddushin (78a): "They agree regarding one who takes back his divorced wife that if he betrothed [her] and did not cohabit [with her], he does not receive lashes; [for] the Torah prohibited [it only] in the manner of building a household." Rather, [the Gemara] stated "betrothed her" because if he died, Rabbi Yochanan and Reish Lakish disagree whether she is bound for yibbum to his brother or not; and [the Gemara] did not state "and went back and cohabited with her," for in that [case] Rabbi Yochanan and Reish Lakish do not disagree, since according to everyone he is not liable to karet for the ḥalutza, and likewise it could have stated "and one of the brothers went back and cohabited with her":

Tosafot on Yevamot 10b:9:1.hebrew: איהו הוא דקאי בלא יבנה - אי לא הוה כתיב "לא יבנה", הוה אמינא דאפילו הוא על החלוצה בכרת, והשתא אייתר "לא יבנה" לנתקה מכרת ללאו, אבל אחין וצרה כדקיימי קיימי, ולא קאי "לא יבנה" עלייהו. ותימה: דבהחולץ (לקמן יבמות דף מד. ושם) משמע דלא אייתר קרא ד"לא יבנה", אלא איצטריך דלא לחלוץ לחדא ולייבם לחדא; דהתם פריך אמתני' ד"מי שהיה נשוי ב' נשים כו'": "ולייבם לתרוייהו?" אמר קרא "בית אחיו" — בית אחד הוא בונה, ואינו בונה שתי בתים. "וליחלוץ לתרוייהו?" אמר קרא "בית חלוץ" — בית אחד הוא חולץ כו'. "וליחלוץ לחדא ולייבם לחדא?" אמר קרא "אשר לא יבנה וכו'". "ולייבם לחדא ולחלוץ לחדא?" אמר קרא "אם לא יחפוץ" — הא אם חפץ מייבם, וכל שאינו עולה לייבום אינו עולה לחליצה. ומיהו אית ספרים דלא גרסינן להו. ואף לספרים דגרסינן, איכא למימר דכי משני בתר הכי "הא חפץ מייבם, וכל שאין עולה לייבום כו'", תו לא איצטריך "לא יבנה" דלא ליחלוץ לחדא ולייבם לחדא, דכיון דאין עולה לחליצה, דאין חולץ שתי בתים, אינו עולה נמי לייבום — והשתא אייתר "לא יבנה" לנתק מכרת ללאו. ובפ' ד' אחין (לקמן יבמות דף לב.) דקאמר: "אי דמייבם והדר חליץ ה"נ, אלא דלמא חליץ ברישא והדר מייבם וקם ליה בלא יבנה" — התם היינו אליבא דרבי יוחנן, דמוקי "לא יבנה" נמי אצרה, אבל לר"ל קם ליה בכרת:
Tosafot on Yevamot 10b:9:1.english: It is he who stands [liable] under "does not build up" - If "does not build up" were not written, I would have said that even he [who performed chalitzah] is [liable to] karet regarding the chalutzah; now, however, "does not build up" is superfluous, [so it serves] to remove her from karet to a [regular] negative prohibition, whereas the brothers and the co-wife remain as they stood, and "does not build up" does not apply to them. And this is perplexing: for in [the chapter entitled] Hacholetz (later, Yevamot 44a and ad loc.), it implies that the verse of "does not build up" is not superfluous, but rather is needed [to teach] that he should not perform chalitzah with one [co-wife] and yibbum with [the other] one; for there [the Gemara] asks on the Mishnah of "One who was married to two wives, etc.": "Let him perform yibbum with both of them?" The verse states, "his brother's house" — he builds one house, and does not build two houses. "Let him perform chalitzah with both of them?" The verse states, "the house of the chalutz" — he performs chalitzah for one house, etc. "Let him perform chalitzah with one and yibbum with one?" The verse states, "who does not build up, etc." "Let him perform yibbum with one and chalitzah with one?" The verse states, "If he does not want" — thus, if he wants, he performs yibbum, and whoever is not eligible for yibbum is not eligible for chalitzah. However, there are versions in which we do not have this reading. And even according to the versions in which we do have [this reading], one can say that once [the Gemara] answers afterward, "if he wants, he performs yibbum, and whoever is not eligible for yibbum, etc.," "does not build up" is no longer needed [to teach] that he should not perform chalitzah with one and yibbum with one — for since he is not eligible for chalitzah, as he does not perform chalitzah for two houses, he is also not eligible for yibbum — and now "does not build up" is superfluous, [serving] to remove [her] from karet to a negative prohibition. And in the chapter [entitled] Arba'ah Achim (later, Yevamot 32a), where [the Gemara] says, "If he performs yibbum first and then chalitzah, so too [it is permitted]; rather, [the concern is] lest he perform chalitzah first and then yibbum, and thereby stand [liable] under 'does not build up'" — there, that is according to Rabbi Yochanan, who applies "does not build up" also to the co-wife, whereas according to Reish Lakish he stands [liable] to karet.
